versions.changelog: Updated metadata and author to use openclaw instead of clawdbot

Initial release of gkeep skill.

- Access Google Keep notes via the gkeepapi unofficial API.
- Features CLI commands to list, search, view, create, archive, and delete notes.
- Requires Google login with an App Password (2FA enabled).
- Stores authentication token securely in user config directory.
- Note: Uses an unofficial API and may break if Google changes its service.
